methodology.cutoffRule: Latest forecast published by the configured cutoff on the day before delivery
methodology.matchingNote: WINDFOR forecasts are hourly average-MW values. FUELHH actuals are half-hourly average-MW values. Each hourly forecast is compared against both the :00 and :30 actuals within that hour (up to 48 matched periods per day). No averaging of actuals is applied.
methodology.warning: The cutoff hour is an explicit prototype assumption; confirm the client's intended trading decision cutoff. Historical forecast endpoint coverage must be validated before relying on results.
